prompt:
Hi — I'm the new Marketing Ops lead at Velochain Technologies. We've got a pretty disorganized CRM database and I need to establish our foundational contact segmentation before we kick off any campaigns this quarter.

I've dropped a `company_profile.json` file in the workspace that describes our business context — our target audience, sales cycle, and what counts as 'engaged' for our team.

Please produce a single file called `lists_config.json` that formally defines all 10 of our core contact segments. Each segment definition needs to capture the full filter logic that our CRM team can implement — including the exact field names, operators, values, logic groupings (AND/OR), and the segment type.

The segments should cover: who we can legally and technically email, our tiered high-priority prospect groups, engaged contacts, customers, partners, contacts overdue for re-engagement, our key personas by job title, contacts at companies in our target industries, and contacts who've engaged with our content.

This will become the master reference document for all campaign builds going forward, so correctness of the filter logic and the relationships between segments is critical.
